description: WSO2 SAP SuccessFactors Job Requisition provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsRecruiting/overview). The service allows to create and manage job requisitions, including their postings, locations, operators, screening questions and translations.
key-features: Create, update and query job requisitions
Manage job postings, locations and requisition operators
Maintain screening questions and their choices
